customers_pdv_name_every.cause: PPBase defect on the D-0019 arrays, independent of the import: a nested field of a multiple relation without '?' matches when any element matches (ppbase/services/filter_parser.py:1268-1282, EXISTS only); PocketBase v0.22.34 requires every element (multi-match, resolvers/record_field_resolve_runner.go:679-681, tools/search/filter.go:184-210)
customers_pdv_name_every.client_impact: a filter or rule on a nested field of buma_customer.pdv, buma_pilotage_ticket.tag or buma_wallet.managers without '?' (here pdv.name ~ ...) selects more records than PocketBase: a list returns records PocketBase leaves out
customers_pdv_name_every.documented_in: D-0025 (remaining PPBase gaps: multi-match of traversals, handled by D-0030)

users_lists_customers_by_role.cause: pre-existing BUMA C3 defect, independent of the import: app/auth/context.py:45-94 (merge_live_auth_context) gives a False default only to isAdmin, to the keys that buma_apps_roles.info.actions declares and to role.*/user.*; an undeclared key of the rule (customer.read, wallet.read, wallet.list) is bound as '' and PostgreSQL refuses '' = TRUE (asyncpg DataError, HTTP 500), even when isAdmin = true already holds. PocketBase v0.22.34 resolves the missing JSON key to NULL and compares it without error (tools/search/filter.go:290-330, resolveEqualExpr): the condition is false
users_lists_customers_by_role.client_impact: HTTP 500 with a plain-text body (text/plain, not the JSON error envelope) instead of 200 or 404 for any record session, admins included, whose role and the buma_apps_roles rows do not declare the key: listing or viewing buma_customer (customer.read) and buma_wallet (wallet.read, wallet.list) fails; with the keys declared, the same rules answer as PocketBase (see declared_permission_keys). Production exposure depends on its roles.permission and buma_apps_roles content (aggregates to measure on the real backup). Cutover blocker until fixed in app/auth/context.py (False default for every key a rule reads) or accepted
users_lists_customers_by_role.documented_in: D-0031 (resolved: an absent permission key is false)

json_content_type_charset.cause: measured: PocketBase v0.22.34 sends JSON answers as application/json; charset=UTF-8 (set by its echo v5 dependency, whose source is not on this server: not verified offline), PPBase as application/json
json_content_type_charset.client_impact: JSON is UTF-8 either way (RFC 8259 section 8.1); only a client that compares the exact Content-Type string differs
json_content_type_charset.documented_in: D-0034 (remaining gaps of the 0.22 mode) and D-0040

evidence_scope.statement: Proves that the synthetic snapshot built by PocketBase is imported faithfully (records, rowids, arrays, preserved anomalies, accounts, settings, token secrets, files) and served by PPBase with the sessions PocketBase issued before the import. Does not prove answer parity with PocketBase 0.22.34: every accepted difference of comparison_with_pocketbase is an open divergence, pre-existing and independent of the import, with its cause, client impact and documentation state.
